notes.title: 2.0.0 Rebalanced every character
notes.notes: [p]Hello! Thank you for playing Cento.[/p][p]In version 2.0.0, I’ve rebalanced every character, and some of them may now require entirely new strategies.[/p][p]I’d love to hear your honest feedback—please share it with me on the official Discord or through the feedback form![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2416050/view/516334711921967291?l=japanese"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/VNfy5tGMLKVMMGoB8"]https://forms.gle/VNfy5tGMLKVMMGoB8[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]◆Additions[/h3][p][b]all characters[/b][/p][list][*][p]［B.〇〇］shot, attack　→　shot, [b]mini attack[/b][/p][/*][*][p]［Mini Attack］On Impact: Deal damage equal to [b]half[/b] Power.[/p][list][*][p]The intent is to highlight each character’s unique tactics.[/p][/*][*][p]Within every playstyle, the blt skill is expected to function in one of two ways:[/p][olist][*][p]Power up the blt skill itself and use it directly,[/p][/*][*][p]Incorporate it into other moves.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][/*][*][p]［Power Note］Gain 1 force on the next turn.[/p][/*][*][p]When Flow Level is 6 or higher, you now gain Focus instead of Force.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tetori[/b][/p][list][*][p]［Lucky Straw］Boosts skill power by half the number of skills used that turn.[/p][/*][*][p]［Daffodil Brooch］Using four Cartridges will grant 1 rapid.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Inagi[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Note Power］On Use: Convert all remaining NP into Power.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Lph[/b][/p][list][*][p]［Sharp］When attack, move the Judge forward by 1. Lose 1 stack at the end of each turn.[/p][/*][*][p]［Express Stamp］Using a skill has a 50% chance to gain dodge1 and cymake it land immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]［BOOSTER］◀▶◀△　→　◀▶◀△▽[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Kazakiri[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Cravis[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［HELLFIR］Magic shot　→　Soul shot 　◀△▽▽　→　◀△▽▶▽[/p][/*][*][p]［Phoenix Ashes］Gain 5 Soulburn when you lose a round.[/p][/*][*][p]［Rusty Key］Gain Soulburn 3 every 3 times the Judge back.[/p][/*][*][p]［Soulburn］（add）Lose 1 stack at the end of turn.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Darlo[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Hanami Dango］When activating two or more skills at once, gain focus 5.[/p][/*][*][p]［Focus］if several moves are triggered at once, the power of every one of them is boosted.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gulai[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Scent］if several moves are triggered at once, the power of every one of them is boosted.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Allium[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Poison］（add）Emptying your deck, halve the value.[/p][/*][*][p]［Spores］Every 5 beats, each stack adds a 10% chance to lose 1 NP. Then lose 1 stack.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Chitose[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Bleed］Inputting a Command will pull the Judge by 1. Lose 1 stack every beat.[/p][/*][*][p]［Tangled Bellywarmer］When bleed Pulls the Judge back, Push it forward by 2.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Kohaku[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Ancient Lightning Rod]（add）At the start of the turn, gain 1 charge if you have none.[/p][/*][*][p]［Thunder Taiko］When you Match a skill, gain 1 charge if you have less than 5. If you have 5 or more, convert charge 1 to guard 1.[/p][/*][*][p]［Yuzu］Using skill with a command length of 4 or more, will grant 1 scent.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Zhu[/b][/p][list][*][p]［RAMUNE］　▽△▽◀　→　▽△▽◀▶[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tula[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Metal Taps］（add）Places a Special Notes each turn.[/p][/*][*][p]［Step］The power increase is now properly applied.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hutaai[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Fog Light］（add）Reduce Smoke density.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ruquel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Anklet］When your flow level increases, gain 1 force.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Acto[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Sticker Bomb］At end of turn, if you have 3 or more status effects, gain 1 force next turn.[/p][/*][*][p]［AMP］Add Exhaust.　▶△△◀▶　→　◀▶△△▽[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tomatoma[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed deck composition.[/p][/*][*][p]［Pressed Tomato Flower］Gain +1 max NP for each of the 4 deck elements.[/p][/*][*][p]［Composter］Gain 1 guard and flow for every two cartridges you exhaust.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Orzo[/b][/p][list][*][p]［Empty Soul Gem］Your shell Cartridges become Adlib, Shot, Mini attack.[/p][/*][*][p]［Golden Horn Ring］Shuffling will add 1 shell to your deck. notes.title: 1.2.1 Fixed medal issues
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes [/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed an issue where players would receive a medal when defeated in Endurance.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed an issue where medals could not be obtained when playing Endurance with the second, third, or fourth custom characters.[/b]
[*]In consideration of the above issue, in version 1.2.1, added a function that allows you to reset the medal of the selected character by pressing [b]Shift + Alt + X[/b] on the character selection screen for Endurance. I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused to your game play.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Cemetery
notes.notes:
[h3]追加要素[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added "Character : Futaai" and "Stage : Cemetery”.
[*]Implemented casual rules in Endurance mode
[/list]
[h3]仕様変更[/h3]
[list]
[*][Wall]  At the start of the turn, decrease the value by 1. → At the start of the turn, decrease the value by 2.
[*][Marshmallow] 10% chance to get 1 Scent. → 20% chance to get 1 Scent.
[/list]
[h3]不具合修正[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a soft lock when deactivating the window while transitioning to the battle screen.
[*]Fixed an issue where the position of Exnote generated by [Steps] would be shifted in songs with a changing beat count.
[*]Several translations have been fixed.

-Some icons in Steam Achievements have been corrected to be displayed correctly.
-When a window is deactivated except during battle, it is not forced to the pause screen.
-When finishing Endurance with a character whose appearance has been changed, the result screen now reflects the changed appearance.
-Fixed the saving process so that when a character's appearance is changed, the save is performed correctly.
-Fixed comments to be displayed correctly when defeated by Tula in the first battle in Endurance.

Fixed a translation error in the conditions for earning achievements.

- [b]Zhu:[/b] Clear Endurance while possessing Crimson whistle and Indigo whistle.
- [b]Kohaku:[/b] Crear Endurance without taking any damage from charge.
